function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate, using only evidence available in the benchmark corpus and current through October 1, 2026, how the Ronin Bridge theft and Harmony Horizon theft may be linked to each other and to Lazarus Group and/or APT38. Produce a source-grounded evidence dossier with the exact source IDs returned by the benchmark tools for every material statement. Cover: (1) public attribution statements, identifying who made each statement, its date, provenance, exact or carefully faithful wording, and whether it is a confirmed government finding, allegation, or analytical assessment; (2) the dates, methods, vulnerabilities or access paths, and any temporal, technical, or operational similarities and differences between the thefts; (3) laundering methods and transaction patterns, including only tool-supported intermediary wallets, asset swaps, cross-chain bridges, mixers, exchanges, sanctions or seizure actions, and service usage; and (4) only explicitly reported wallet addresses, fund flows, address reuse, clustering, and relationships to the thefts or to Lazarus Group/APT38. Do not infer wallet ownership, entity IDs, relationship names, or attribution from generic similarity. Explicitly record uncertainty, contradictory wording, missing evidence, and limits of any clustering or tracing methodology. Organize the output so another writer can prepare a complete readable Markdown report and a final JSON object with findings, claims, reasoning_steps, and contradictions. Do not use unsupported facts or uncited general knowledge."}
function.name: ConductResearch
